nodes.label: algoliasearch==3.0.0
nodes.rationale: v3 client is synchronous; calls run in a thread pool.

nodes.label: Ingestion pipeline
nodes.rationale: Clear previous records only after successful fetch so transient GitHub errors don't wipe a working index.

nodes.label: Background Indexing Job
nodes.rationale: At most two repositories index at once; one job per repository at a time.

nodes.label: Indexing file limits
nodes.rationale: Skip dist/build/vendor/node_modules, minified and lockfiles; max 1000 files <1MB, 100MB total per repo.

nodes.label: Bridge logs to stderr
nodes.rationale: stdout carries the MCP protocol.

nodes.label: Regex search time budget
nodes.rationale: At most 1s per file and 10s per call; skipped_files/truncated reported.

nodes.label: BrowserRequestGuard (app/core/security.py)
nodes.rationale: Blocks cross-origin browser writes since prod nginx adds key to any request with browser login; blocks DNS rebinding/LAN access without key.

nodes.label: CORS_ORIGINS
nodes.rationale: '*' rejected; browser writes from other origins get 403.

nodes.label: slowapi rate limiting
nodes.rationale: 100/min on repo create/process and search suggestions; 30/min on MCP tool-call and resource-read.

nodes.label: One backend worker
nodes.rationale: Job state, WebSocket subscriptions and rate-limit counters in-process; SQLite is single-writer.

nodes.label: Per-stack Algolia index
nodes.rationale: Records keyed by repository id; two databases sharing an index would delete each other's records.

nodes.label: Single worker constraint
nodes.rationale: Job state and WebSocket subscriptions live in the server process.

nodes.label: nginx HTTP basic auth
nodes.rationale: Prod keeps API key out of browser: nginx asks for password and injects X-API-Key on /api and /ws.

nodes.label: CODESAGE_API_KEY
nodes.rationale: Required unless bound to loopback; backend refuses to start with non-loopback MCP_SERVER_HOST and no key.

nodes.label: VITE_CODESAGE_API_KEY
nodes.rationale: Inlined into the JS bundle, so the setup is local single-user only.

nodes.label: codesage.key WebSocket subprotocol auth
nodes.rationale: Key never placed in the URL because access logs record URLs.

nodes.label: Status polling fallback
nodes.rationale: Polls status endpoint while repository pending/processing in addition to /ws.

nodes.label: Neural Network Motif
nodes.rationale: Five white circles linked by lines in a closed loop over the brain, symbolizing neural connections / AI reasoning

nodes.label: brainGradient (indigo-violet gradient)
nodes.rationale: Linear gradient #6366f1 to #8b5cf6 (Tailwind indigo-500 to violet-500) with #4f46e5 stroke, matching the app's indigo/violet brand palette

nodes.label: CodeSage Favicon (Brain Icon)
nodes.rationale: 32x32 SVG app icon depicting a stylized brain with white neural nodes and connection lines, conveying AI/code intelligence branding for the CodeSage frontend
